verdicts_or_reports.field: due date after completing repeating task
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Completing "Final dose" (repeats daily, occurs 1 time, due Monday, December 14) should either move it to the next occurrence (Tuesday, December 15) or mark it done since its single repeat is used up. It should not stay on December 14.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tapping its checkbox showed the snackbar "Final dose rescheduled for December 14". The task stays unchecked under "Due Monday, December 14", and its editor still shows "Monday, December 14" with "Repeats daily, occurs 1 time". By comparison, "Weekly review" (every 2 weeks) moved from Dec 14 to Dec 28 correctly, and "Pay rent" (monthly) moved to January 4, 2027.
steps: On the My Tasks list, note 'Final dose' under 'Due Monday, December 14'.
Tap its checkbox (completeBox) at the left of the row.
Observe the snackbar: 'Final dose rescheduled for December 14'. The row is still unchecked under December 14.
Open 'Final dose': due date is Monday, December 14 and repeat is 'Repeats daily, occurs 1 time'. Press Back without saving.
For comparison, complete 'Weekly review' (every 2 weeks, due December 14): snackbar says 'rescheduled for December 28' (correct).

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Pressing the system Back gesture while search results are shown should close search and return to the main My Tasks list (the app stays open).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After submitting a query, the screen shows 'Matching 'tickets'' with no search bar. One Back press left Tasks.org entirely and showed the Android launcher home screen.
steps: On My Tasks, tap the Search icon at the bottom bar.
Type 'tickets' into the search field and press Enter (submit).
Observe the title 'Matching 'tickets'' and the results list 'Print tickets'. The search bar is no longer visible.
Press the system Back button once.
Observe: the app closes and the Android launcher home screen is shown instead of the My Tasks list.

sign_off.notes: Sweep of task list, search, editor, subtasks and repeating tasks. Two bugs were filed and confirmed by the developer; I am signing off on the rest, but confidence is only moderate because the sign-off is not a clean pass. Filed: (1) completing 'Final dose' (repeats daily, occurs 1 time, due Dec 14) shows 'rescheduled for December 14' and leaves the task on the same date; (2) after submitting a search (e.g. 'tickets'), one system Back press exits the app to the launcher instead of returning to the My Tasks list. Verified OK: Pay rent monthly (Dec 4 -> Jan 4 2027 -> Feb 4 2027, Undo restores); Weekly review every 2 weeks (Dec 14 -> Dec 28); Water plants hourly (10 AM -> 11 AM -> 12 PM); subtask badge counts 2 -> 1 -> 0 and back to 1 on Undo, and disappears when the last subtask is deleted; new subtask via editor shows badge; blank subtask row not saved; search by subtask name, empty-state for no match, clear query restores list; Back from editor opened via search returns to search results; editor discard keeps original title; 'Recently modified' filter persists after opening and leaving an editor; rotation keeps list state. Not checked: sort options, Today filter, reminders, link tap on 'Read docs' notes. Not filed, unclear: a newly created subtask ('Check link') opened with Priority = Low (blue) while its parent 'Read docs' has None; I did not set that, and I could not confirm the intended default.
